treatment.schedule_summary: Paclitaxel50mg/m² (45mg/m² only if prescribed) plus carboplatinAUC2 weekly for7weeks with concurrent RT.

radiotherapy.timing: Concurrent with seven-week chemotherapy course; separate radiation prescription.

optional_follow_on.note: Consultant may prescribe separate carboplatinAUC6/paclitaxel200mg/m² consolidation after RT. Not automatically added or interpreted as weekly-cycle extension.

eligibility: StageIII NSCLC; ECOG0–2; unsuitable for cisplatin because of comorbidity/renal function; adequate organ function, baseline ANC>1.5 and platelets≥100.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity; pregnancy/breastfeeding; severe hepatic impairment; baseline neutrophils<1.5; significant pleural effusions.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profiles; measuredGFR preferred or verified estimate; audiology and neuropathy assessment if indicated.
FBC with differential, renal and liver profiles weekly; neuropathy assessment as indicated.
Calculated GFR: creatinine within48hours; isotope baseline creatinine>110% prompts reassessment.
Response imaging, markers if useful and follow-up are consultant planned, with no fixed NCCP timetable; reassess respiratory/swallowing symptoms during and after RT.
dose_modifications: Baseline and weekly count thresholds differ; exact ANC/platelet/ALT/bilirubin boundary gaps require review.
Carboplatin renal rules and paclitaxel hepatic rules are component specific; no imported generic neuropathy percentage.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: CarboplatinAUC2 is moderate, not the AUC≥4 high-risk pathway; separate paclitaxel reaction premedication reconciled weekly.
